video_title: POSTGAME SOUND: CLEVELAND CAVALIERS VS. ORLANDO MAGIC | COACH SWEENEY, PAOLO BANCHERO & JALEN SUGGS

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on team ball movement and aggressive play
quotes.excerpt: I love the way the ball moved. I thought we did a really good job of playing extremely aggressively
quotes.quote: I love the way the ball moved. I thought we did a really good job of playing extremely aggressively and making every option live on offense. And then defensively, I thought we did a really good job of understanding what we were trying to get accomplished from a scheme standpoint, and then the carryover on things that we wanted to improve upon last game, I thought we did a really good job with that.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney on the Magic offense: I love the way the ball moved. I thought we did a really good job of playing extremely aggressively and making every option live on offense.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on the aggressive play of Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs
quotes.excerpt: I thought their aggressiveness was great. Both those guys have the ability to make plays in different areas
quotes.quote: I thought their aggressiveness was great. Both those guys have the ability to make plays in different areas and I love how they're playing together. The way they started the game, I thought they did a really nice job on both ends, frankly, but on the offensive end, I thought their aggressiveness was great.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney on the chemistry between Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs: Both those guys have the ability to make plays in different areas and I love how they are playing together.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on Jalen Suggs' impact and consistent effort
quotes.excerpt: I thought he was really good in terms of his consistent effort, consistent disposition throughout the game
quotes.quote: I thought he was really good in terms of his consistent effort, consistent disposition throughout the game. And we see the way he can impact the game, making good decisions on both ends, and then providing instant energy when he's out there.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney praises Jalen Suggs for his consistent effort and ability to provide instant energy on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on the team's rebounding and second-chance points
quotes.excerpt: We made it a point of emphasis to go to the boards on both ends
quotes.quote: We made it a point of emphasis to go to the boards on both ends and really try to be aggressive to hit and check when they do crash. And then on our end, making sure that we play by our rules on the crash rules, really attack the boards. We did a good job both ends and I think the second chance points for us, we saw 19 second chance points, so that was pretty good. I like that.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney says the Magic made rebounding a point of emphasis tonight, resulting in 19 second chance points.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on Tristan da Silva's development and shooting
quotes.excerpt: He's done a really nice job on both ends. Tristan, I think in each of the three preseason games
quotes.quote: He's done a really nice job on both ends. Tristan, I think in each of the three preseason games we've had, he's shot over 10 threes and I love the aggressiveness he's showing. He's hunting the right shots and then defensively, he's done a really good job with his positioning. He's been picking up our schemes really well and then he makes great effort plays throughout the course of his minutes.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney is impressed with rookie Tristan da Silva: In each of the three preseason games we have had, he has shot over 10 threes and I love the aggressiveness he is showing.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on the team's ongoing development and foundation
quotes.excerpt: We're still trying to get that foundation in place and then add layers to it
quotes.quote: We're still trying to get that foundation in place and then add layers to it. But just in general, I think we've done a nice job and now we've got to keep building.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney on the team's progress: We are still trying to get that foundation in place and then add layers to it. We have done a nice job and now we have to keep building.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on Tristan da Silva's shooting volume
quotes.excerpt: What's the most he can take? I mean that to me is a number for him
quotes.quote: What's the most he can take? I mean that to me is a number for him. I think he's a phenomenal shooter. He works at it. He does a great job of finding the right shots and so if the opportunity presents itself to take five, take five. If it's 10, take 10. If it's 15, take 15. And then make the right decision when you have the ball each time. Good with whatever comes with it.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney on Tristan da Silva's high volume shooting: If the opportunity presents itself to take five, take five. If it is 10, take 10. If it is 15, take 15.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on team ball movement and defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: I thought the ball was moving really well. Thought we played fast and then defensively just contesting
quotes.quote: I thought the ball was moving really well. Thought we played fast and then defensively just contesting all their shots, trying not to give them any easy looks, and just being aggressive on both sides of the court.
quotes.social_post: Paolo Banchero on the win: I thought the ball was moving really well. Thought we played fast and then defensively just contesting all their shots.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on the starting unit's chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Thought we were physical both ends of the court and the ball was moving
quotes.quote: Thought we were physical both ends of the court and the ball was moving. Thought we got into things we were trying to run with pace and yeah, we just had a good flow.
quotes.social_post: Paolo Banchero on the starting unit: Thought we were physical both ends of the court and the ball was moving. We just had a good flow.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on setting the tone with Jalen Suggs
quotes.excerpt: Just being aggressive both of us, looking for each other and trying to lead the way
quotes.quote: Just being aggressive both of us, looking for each other and trying to lead the way and continue to put pressure on the defense. You know, I think me and him have an ability to do that at all times when we're on the floor, so just trying to, you know, continue to expand on that and continue to play off one another and just be aggressive.
quotes.social_post: Paolo Banchero on his partnership with Jalen Suggs: Me and him have an ability to put pressure on the defense at all times when we are on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on team comfort and execution in the offense
quotes.excerpt: Everybody's been picking it up pretty well. We've put in a lot of time and just working
quotes.quote: Everybody's been picking it up pretty well. We've put in a lot of time and just working on it, working together in the gym, you know, since the beginning of September. So, you know, obviously we still got a way to go, but I think guys are picking it up and starting to, you know, find what we're trying to do and when teams take something away, find what's next in another way we can still get a good shot.
quotes.social_post: Paolo Banchero says the team has been working on their new offensive system since September and are starting to find a rhythm.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on the consistency and efficiency of Jalen Suggs
quotes.excerpt: He's always been this player in my eyes, so that's what we want him to do
quotes.quote: Honestly, he's just being himself. He's always been this player in my eyes, so that's what we want him to do. Go out there, be aggressive, be who he is, be aggressive, and put pressure on the defense. When he's guarding, put pressure on the ball handler and just be a two-way player.
quotes.social_post: Paolo Banchero on Jalen Suggs: He is just being himself. He is always been this player in my eyes, so that is what we want him to do.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on the team's new system and collective involvement
quotes.excerpt: I think coach has done a great job of just using all five guys on the floor
quotes.quote: I think coach has done a great job of just using all five guys on the floor and kind of making everybody a threat, whether you have the ball or don't have the ball. You know, the ball may find you and just knowing what to do once it does. I think it's suited our team well and I think everybody feels involved in what we're doing, no matter who has the ball in their hands. I think guys all feel engaged in the offense and seek their opportunities and are aggressive when their opportunities come.
quotes.social_post: Paolo Banchero on the new offensive scheme: Coach has done a great job of just using all five guys on the floor and kind of making everybody a threat.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Suggs on the team's simple and effective offensive execution
quotes.excerpt: I think we kept it pretty simple. I think that's the beauty about what we're doing
quotes.quote: I think we kept it pretty simple. I think that's the beauty about what we're doing is that there's a lot of complexities, you know, that we're going to get to in time, but it's pretty simple for the most part. So, I think we're really fast and fast is, you know, up and down in transition, but I think we sprinted in and out of our screens. I think we're quick in moving the ball, moving the ball with a lot of pop and then quick in our decision making, whether we're shooting the ball, quick with our, you know, swing throughs, attacking, looking for drives and then sprinting out and being aggressive in our decision making.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Suggs on the Magic offense: We kept it pretty simple. We are really fast and we are quick in moving the ball with a lot of pop.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Suggs on returning to the court after preseason absence
quotes.excerpt: I was pretty eager to get back out on the court. It was a bit hard
quotes.quote: I was pretty eager to get back out on the court. Like I said, it was a bit hard on the mental, you know, sitting out those two, so I said, just excited to get back out on the floor, throw the jersey on and just play the game. So, like I said, the game, I felt really simple, reads felt simple. You know, just came down to coming out and executing, doing, you know, what the coaches have been telling us to do and like I said, executing what they've been coaching us on.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Suggs on returning to the court after missing time: It was a bit hard on the mental sitting out those two, so I was just excited to get back out on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Suggs on the team's offensive flow and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: Moving the ball, moving our bodies, sprinting, like I said, pace, sprinting in and out of screens
quotes.quote: Moving the ball, moving our bodies, sprinting, like I said, pace, sprinting in and out of screens, sprinting the floor, throwing the ball ahead, moving the ball in half court and taking open shots with confidence. You know, I think you put all those things together and you have a pretty potent offense. So, I think we all believe in the things that we're doing. Coaches have done a great job in implementing, you know, the style of play and the intricacies within our offense.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Suggs on the keys to the offense: Moving the ball, moving our bodies, sprinting in and out of screens, and taking open shots with confidence.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Suggs on Paolo Banchero's playmaking and high-level performance
quotes.excerpt: Paolo is always been high level. He's a smart basketball player. Handles always been really elite
quotes.quote: Paolo is always been high level. He's a smart basketball player. Handles always been really elite and again, like I said, he's very intelligent. So, you know, he's always looking to make the right basketball play, whether that's for himself or with the pass to the assist or for the hockey assist, which I think is a very important skill. So, a lot of props to him. It's fun to play basketball with him and I've always felt like I could shoot the ball, so I think it's more mental than anything. Put in the reps, come out and shoot the ball.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Suggs on Paolo Banchero: Paolo has always been high level. He is a smart basketball player. It is fun to play basketball with him.
